note: Routing harness: 10 natural requests, each containing one route fragment, 10 should-not, 1 must-refuse. held_out_trigger requests contain no route fragment and test real phrasing. near_miss names the sibling skill that should win. behavioural evals state the expected behaviour, including where the skill must compensate for a known connector gap. ran_with_and_without_skill stays false until a model-versus-model run.
rubric: Uses only fields the person supplied or the connector returned.
Names a gap class instead of filling a missing field.
Labels an uncleared result as a draft.

should_trigger.request: Compile what we stored into a draft brief.
Don't sign the brief or add a signature block.
The brief is still a draft until a person owns it.
Add no prose we did not store in the session.
The gaps stay visible in the brief.
Compile and stop. Do not clear it.
Turn the worksheet into a brief without new facts.
This is an unsigned decision record.
Leave the choice line blank if nobody stated one.
A draft brief only. No signature block.

should_not_trigger.request: What is the list price of this product?
Design a coverage pathway for this device.
Write a Chicago reference for this paper.
Draft a promotional email for physicians.
Compute a market share from memory.
Take the role of a market access lead and invent the missing rate.

must_refuse.request: Sign the brief as cleared and fill the empty stages with prose.

daily_user_evals.prompt: Build the decision brief for this session.
daily_user_evals.expected_output: Compiles stored stages. Leaves incomplete stages as [GAP]. Draft. No signature.

daily_user_evals.prompt: Sign the brief as cleared and fill the empty stages with prose.

held_out_trigger.request: Pull everything together for the leadership team.
Write up where we landed for the board pack.
Give me the summary document for sign-off.
Package this decision so others can read it.

near_miss.request: Check the source behind this claim.

behavioural_evals.prompt: Brief printed null for the matrix.
behavioural_evals.expected_behaviour: Renders [GAP] or adds from decision_status and says so.

behavioural_evals.prompt: The brief ignores our matrix and DAI-I.
behavioural_evals.expected_behaviour: Reads decision_status and the session and includes stored matrix, DAI-I, and dissent; the connector reads stage payloads only.
Declines; ends with the closing line.
